request.question: How much higher was revenue in 2193-Q3 than in 2193-Q4, in dollars, and what share of the whole year's revenue was Q4?

reply:
I compared revenue, all genres, between 2193-Q4 and 2193-Q3. Q3 revenue was about $274,036 and Q4 was about $161,525. Q3 was higher by about $112,511.

I can't give you Q4's share of the year. The terminal has no share measure, and I don't work out ratios myself. I can show revenue by quarter for the year if you'd like.
